timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹13,942.4 Cr (+1.8% YoY), net profit ₹4,196.04 Cr (+5.5% YoY).
Hindustan Aeronautics Limited hosted Q4FY26 earnings call on May 15, 2026, at 16:00 hrs via Ambit Capital Pvt Ltd, recording available at hal-india.co.in/investors/analyst-investors-meet.
HAL's Q4FY26 earnings call on 15 May 2026 guided FY27 revenue growth of 10-12% and 30-31% EBITDA margin, with LCA deliveries expected from August-September 2026.
Ministry of Defence’s **Manisha Chandra, IAS (Joint Secretary)** declares President of India holds no encumbered HAL shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) on April 2, 2026.
